{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders (status == 'completed')
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter for LOYAL customers (customer_segment == 'loyal')
loyal_customers = completed_orders[completed_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_customers['revenue'].mean()

# Print result
print('Mean revenue of completed orders from LOYAL customers:', mean_revenue)"}
